purpose: Test whether jointly supervising both real outcomes of an identical observed prefix/request makes the world model use observations, preserve earlier InDrawer, and improve future predictions. h0 generalization remains a separate gate.
single_change: New-data root slot0: b0 -> b1; slot1: b2 unchanged. Control is prior recovery b0+b2; new arm is b1+b2.
effect_scope: Skill-family order and global target-color quotas unchanged, but positive target identity changes within each root at action indices1/3 and subsequent real positive trajectory changes. Therefore effect includes matched-request outcome coverage AND changed per-root positive target/trajectory; not merely an added pairing annotation.

training.initialization: Same original joint latest6000 weights AND AdamW moments, seeds0/1
training.schedule: Exact byte copies of old/new/latent schedules from prior trial. Same root×slot at each sample; map slot0 to b1 instead of b0. Every root and both branches must have positive counts. No per-batch forced pair or reshuffling.
training.optimizer: AdamW betas(.9,.999),weight_decay.0001; original E/R separate clip1
training.loss: Exact previous original full k3 + same corrected true-terminal posterior term

selection: Same development6 roots/all3 branches. Evaluate objective at500/1000 using same scorer/RNG81831; choose minimum, tie earlier. Also report fixed1000; no criterion/threshold/checkpoint changes after results.

evaluation.inference: Same previous sealed evaluator, 8 samples, paired root RNG, continuous real observations; one-step and pure suffix1/2/3 from h2

diagnostic_gates.training_necessary: Both seeds: h0 held12/12 AND h2 matched b1/b2 Held plus correct all InDrawer and drawer simultaneously12/12. This is an internal mechanism gate, not original-guide acceptance.
diagnostic_gates.development_generalizing_support: Both seeds must improve complete h2 pair correctness AND complete paired3-step-prefix over prior recovery control; h0 held and h2 true-A-InDrawer retention must not regress. Report failure of any component; no post-hoc relaxed gate.
diagnostic_gates.historical_evaluation: Exploratory regression only; never model selection or blind acceptance.
diagnostic_gates.predictive_meaning: Pre-h2 prior must be identical across hidden-fault pair; do not demand advance prediction of exogenous noise. Count prior-to-posterior corrections and regressions, pair discrimination, past relation retention, then actual post-h2 consequences.

resource_cap: Two new1000-update fits if strict reuse audit passes; no extra training beyond stated fits; total round about30min. If reuse mismatch, stop and report matching-retrain need rather than silently use incompatible control.
